name: pro-electron
description: Electron skills: electron-skills-bridge (routes Electron work to two pinned upstream engines installed with /pro-dev install: jwynia electron-best-practices for architecture, security, IPC and packaging; laststance electron-release for signing, notarization and publishing), electron-upgrade (major-version upgrade workflow for Electron and its tooling) and electron-security-audit (read-only audit of an Electron app against the official security checklist). Driving the running app through Playwright MCP over CDP is a manual setup the skills describe, not something the plugin installs.
